subject.title: Feature: config-level default task notify policy

question: Should OpenClaw add a config-backed default task notify policy, and should that surface be one global default or a per-runtime policy map?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing a public config key and default semantics affects existing channel notification volume and cannot be safely inferred by automation.

options.title: Add per-runtime defaults
options.body: Introduce an agents.defaults.tasks.notifyPolicy map so ACP/subagent behavior can be tuned while cron, CLI, and media defaults remain explicit.

options.title: Add one global default
options.body: Use a simpler agents.defaults.tasks.defaultNotifyPolicy key, accepting that callers must override more paths to preserve today’s runtime differences.

options.title: Decline new config
options.body: Keep the existing per-task CLI override and address only narrower runtime/channel issues such as Discord visibility or ACP runaway loops.

recommendation.title: Add per-runtime defaults
recommendation.body: Introduce an agents.defaults.tasks.notifyPolicy map so ACP/subagent behavior can be tuned while cron, CLI, and media defaults remain explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest recent history on task delivery policy, task registry defaults, and ACP/subagent task routing.
